description: This file defines the TimeParts class which provides static methods to extract hour, minute, and second components from various time representations in Excel, PHP, or string formats. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library and facilitates time component extraction within spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: TimeParts
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to extract hour, minute, and second components from time values in various formats.

methods.name: hour
methods.description: Returns the hour component (0-23) from a given time value, handling arrays and various input types.

methods.name: minute
methods.description: Returns the minute component (0-59) from a given time value, handling arrays and various input types.

methods.name: second
methods.description: Returns the seconds component (0-59) from a given time value, handling arrays and various input types.
